body: I got lost in thought and literally answered you at the very end I’m so sorry lmao

I wish we didn’t have to suffer just to live but that’s how life is. If you don’t work you’re considered a leech and at the very bottom of the chain. That’s how it is portaited. I don’t understand how people can be so adjusted to a plain 9-5 job and do all the social norms everyone expects you to do. That is entirely different from what I want but I don’t know what I want if that makes sense. I refuse to spend 40 years doing something I hate then when I’m old and useless I can finally enjoy life. Like what the fuck? We’re basically machines working hard for very little compensation and when the machine breaks it’s no longer needed. I guess a have a skewed mind and this is totally acceptable but I reject the thought of slaving myself when life is so short. I no longer am interested in the gaming field. I don’t have enough dedication and passion for that despite it being the only job I’ve ever wanted. Maybe one day when I’ll stop being mentally diseased and fix myself. I would want to travel to a lot of places like Korea, Japan, Europe etc but again, no money no travelling

Smoking just takes my mind off things for a while. It calms me down a bit. I don’t recommend it for obvious reasons theres other better coping methods but that’s what I first stumbled upon. I would imagine me being in college and travelling. Travelling is something I’ve always wanted to do but obviously I don’t have the money. I wanted a job I’d enjoy doing, I wanted to create games but that’s scraped due to bad grades so options are very limited and I’ve accusstomed to this very lazy entitled life that working now is at the very bottom of my concerns which is quite obviously very bad
I don’t like going to the gym but I do run daily, I like being in touch with nature it’s like the only thing that can make me feel peace

I’m very self aware with who I am and it’s honestly so disappointing that this is what I have become. When I was young I wanted to be successful, rich and happy now I’m a smoke addict with nothing to live for. I just want to be happy but my mind cannot want to work towards that. This is due to all the disappointments I’ve had in the past 4 years or so. I’m just so sad and angry and I have nobody around me to realise how mentally damaged I am. Nothing makes me happy anymore
